sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.,Gaurav Kumar Shukla,Vasundhra
Hon'ble Saumitra Dayal Singh,J.
Hon'ble Sandeep Jain,J.
1.
Supplementary affidavit filed today is taken on record.
2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned A.G.A. for the State and Sri Gaurav Kumar Shukla learned counsel for the informant.

3. After some argument in the matter, learned counsel for the petitioner prays to withdraw the instant writ petition instituted with the prayer to quash the First Information Report dated 02.03.2025 registered as Case Crime No.0057 of 2025, under Sections 376, 504, 506 IPC, P.S.
Lalganj, District Basti, with liberty to pursue his statutory remedies available under the B.N.S.S.

sentences.text: 4. Learned A.G.A. and learned counsel for the first informant have no objection.
5. The writ petition is, accordingly, dismissed as withdrawn, with the liberty as prayed for.
6. Certified copy of the FIR shall be returned to learned counsel for the petitioner by the Registry after retaining its copy on record.
